  <h3>BigBang: Pursuing Open-Ended Intelligence through Self-Evolving Synthesis of Verifiable Frontier Tasks</h3>
  <p>BigBang is a general-purpose 35B-A3B model post-trained on verifiable frontier tasks generated by an adversarial, self-evolving generator-critic framework. Calibrated with held-out research tasks, the pipeline iteratively improves task difficulty and evaluation quality, yielding broad gains in scientific research, reasoning, coding, and tool use.</p>

  <h3>DataPrep-Bench: Benchmarking LLMs as Training Data Preparators</h3>
  <p>DataPrep-Bench is the first unified, downstream-grounded benchmark for evaluating how LLMs, agents, and data-centric workflows construct supervised training data and predict candidate datasets&#x27; downstream utility. It also introduces a skill-guided construction agent and the Distributional Alignment Score, which outperforms existing quality, diversity, and heuristic evaluators across most tested domains.</p>

<article class="paper-card" id="powlu-an-activation-function-for-stable-pre-training-of-llms">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2026.05</span>
    <span>Optimization</span>
  </div>
  <h3>PowLU: An Activation Function for Stable Pre-Training of LLMs</h3>
  <p>This paper identifies SwiGLU&#x27;s near-quadratic amplification on large positive inputs as a source of outliers and numerical instability in low-precision large-scale LLM pre-training. It proposes Power Linear Unit (PowLU), a rational-power activation that preserves adaptive nonlinearity while stabilizing spike regions, with scaling-law and Ling-model experiments showing competitive performance and improved training scalability.</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25704" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />Paper</a>
  </div>
</article>
<article class="paper-card" id="pre-training-llm-without-learning-rate-decay-enhances-supervised-fine-tuning">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2026.03</span>
    <span>Optimization</span>
  </div>
  <h3>Pre-training LLM without Learning Rate Decay Enhances Supervised Fine-Tuning</h3>
  <p>This paper shows that Warmup-Stable-Only pre-training, which keeps the learning rate constant after warmup, consistently improves downstream SFT performance over decay-based schedules across 1B and 8B models. Its loss-landscape analysis attributes the gain to flatter minima that preserve model adaptability.</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.16127" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />Paper</a>
  </div>
</article>

  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2023.06</span>
    <span>Distillation</span>
  </div>
  <h3>Knowledge Distillation of Large Language Models</h3>
  <p>This paper studies white-box knowledge distillation for generative LLMs and proposes MiniLLM, replacing the standard forward KLD objective with reverse KLD to avoid overestimating low-probability teacher regions. The method derives an effective optimization procedure and improves instruction-following quality, calibration, exposure bias, and long-text generation across model families from 120M to 13B parameters.</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
